title: PNP: 1 Chinese, 2 Malaysians behind ‘parcel scam hub’ in Pasay City

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — A Chinese national and two Malaysians are the masterminds behind a “parcel scam hub” that operated for three months, said Philippine National Police (PNP) authorities on Tuesday. “As of now meron tayong three masterminds. One Chinese and two Malaysians,” said PNP chief Gen. Jose Melencio Nartatez Jr. in a briefing at a Pasay City office, where the scam hub was located. (As of now we have three masterminds. One Chinese and two Malaysians) “As of now, we have rounded up 159 individuals,” said Criminal Investigation and Detection Group for the National Capital Region (CIDG-NCR) chief Police Col.
